name: PyVista Mesh Processing
description: Mesh geometry operations powered by PyVista/VTK: decimation, subdivision, smoothing (Laplacian, Taubin), cleaning, hole filling, normal computation, triangulation, and surface extraction.

videos.title: 3D Mesh, Point Cloud & Volume Processing with Open3D
Mesh, Voxels & Volumes: Binary Erosion and Marching Cubes

theory.overview:
PyVista wraps VTK filters for mesh geometry processing. Operations include:

**Decimation** reduces triangle count using quadric error metrics.
**Subdivision** refines meshes by splitting triangles (linear, butterfly, loop).
**Smoothing** removes noise via Laplacian $\mathbf{v}_i' = \mathbf{v}_i + \lambda \Delta \mathbf{v}_i$ or Taubin's $\lambda|\mu$ scheme.
**Cleaning** merges duplicate points and removes degenerate cells.
**Triangulation** converts polygonal cells to triangles.

pv_decimate.title: Mesh Decimation
pv_decimate.content: Reduces mesh complexity by collapsing edges based on quadric error metrics. Target reduction is a fraction $r \in [0,1)$ of triangles to remove.

pv_subdivide.title: Mesh Subdivision
pv_subdivide.content: Refines mesh by splitting triangles. Linear splits at midpoints; butterfly and loop use interpolation for smoother results.

pv_smooth_laplacian.title: Laplacian Smoothing
pv_smooth_laplacian.content: Iteratively moves each vertex toward the centroid of its neighbors: $\mathbf{v}_i' = \mathbf{v}_i + \lambda \frac{1}{|N_i|} \sum_{j \in N_i}(\mathbf{v}_j - \mathbf{v}_i)$.

pv_smooth_taubin.title: Taubin Smoothing
pv_smooth_taubin.content: Alternates shrinking ($\lambda > 0$) and inflating ($\mu < 0$) steps to smooth without volume shrinkage. Pass-band controls the cutoff frequency.

pv_clean.title: Clean Mesh
pv_clean.content: Merges coincident points, removes degenerate cells, and strips unused points within the specified tolerance.

pv_fill_holes.title: Fill Holes
pv_fill_holes.content: Identifies boundary edges and fills holes smaller than the specified size by generating new triangular faces.

pv_compute_normals.title: Compute Normals
pv_compute_normals.content: Computes point and cell normals from triangle geometry. Consistency flips normals to face outward.

pv_triangulate.title: Triangulate
pv_triangulate.content: Converts all polygonal cells (quads, n-gons) into triangles for uniform processing.

pv_extract_surface.title: Extract Surface
pv_extract_surface.content: Extracts the outer surface of a volumetric or unstructured grid as a polygonal mesh.

parameters.name: target_reduction
parameters.description: Fraction of triangles to remove (0.5 = remove 50%).

parameters.name: volume_preservation
parameters.description: Constrain decimation to preserve mesh volume (slower, less shrinkage).

parameters.name: attribute_error
parameters.description: Include scalar/attribute error in the decimation cost metric.

parameters.name: normals
parameters.description: Include normals deviation in the decimation cost metric.

parameters.name: boundary_constraints
parameters.description: Use legacy boundary-edge-length weighting for boundary quadric constraints.

parameters.name: n_subdivisions
parameters.description: Number of subdivision iterations.

parameters.name: algorithm
parameters.description: Subdivision algorithm: linear, butterfly, or loop.

parameters.name: n_iterations
parameters.description: Number of smoothing iterations.

parameters.name: relaxation_factor
parameters.description: Step size per iteration (higher = more smoothing).

parameters.name: convergence
parameters.description: Convergence threshold; smaller = more iterations. 0 disables early stop.

parameters.name: edge_angle
parameters.description: Edge angle (deg) for interior edge features when feature_smoothing is on.

parameters.name: feature_angle
parameters.description: Feature angle (deg) for sharp-feature detection when feature_smoothing is on.

parameters.name: boundary_smoothing
parameters.description: Allow boundary (edge) vertices to move during smoothing.

parameters.name: feature_smoothing
parameters.description: Smooth along detected sharp features rather than freezing them.

parameters.name: n_iterations
parameters.description: Number of smoothing iterations.

parameters.name: pass_band
parameters.description: Pass-band value controlling cutoff frequency.

parameters.name: edge_angle
parameters.description: Edge angle (deg) for interior edge features when feature_smoothing is on.

parameters.name: feature_angle
parameters.description: Feature angle (deg) for sharp-feature detection when feature_smoothing is on.

parameters.name: boundary_smoothing
parameters.description: Allow boundary (edge) vertices to move during smoothing.

parameters.name: feature_smoothing
parameters.description: Smooth along detected sharp features rather than freezing them.

parameters.name: non_manifold_smoothing
parameters.description: Also smooth non-manifold vertices.

parameters.name: normalize_coordinates
parameters.description: Normalize coordinates before smoothing for better numerical stability.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: Merge tolerance (0 = exact duplicates only).

parameters.name: point_merging
parameters.description: Merge coincident points within tolerance.

parameters.name: absolute
parameters.description: Interpret tolerance as an absolute distance (else fraction of bounding box).

parameters.name: lines_to_points
parameters.description: Convert degenerate lines (zero length) to points.

parameters.name: polys_to_lines
parameters.description: Convert degenerate polygons to lines.

parameters.name: strips_to_polys
parameters.description: Convert degenerate triangle strips to polygons.

parameters.name: hole_size
parameters.description: Maximum hole size to fill.

parameters.name: flip_normals
parameters.description: Flip all normals (0=no, 1=yes).

parameters.name: consistency
parameters.description: Enforce consistent normal orientation (0=no, 1=yes).

parameters.name: cell_normals
parameters.description: Compute per-cell (face) normals.

parameters.name: point_normals
parameters.description: Compute per-point (vertex) normals.

parameters.name: split_vertices
parameters.description: Split vertices along sharp edges (creates duplicate points at hard edges).

parameters.name: auto_orient_normals
parameters.description: Automatically orient normals outward (assumes a closed manifold).

parameters.name: non_manifold_traversal
parameters.description: Prevent orientation propagation across non-manifold edges.

parameters.name: feature_angle
parameters.description: Feature angle (deg) used when split_vertices is on.

parameters.name: pass_pointid
parameters.description: Keep original point ids as a 'vtkOriginalPointIds' array on the surface.

parameters.name: pass_cellid
parameters.description: Keep original cell ids as a 'vtkOriginalCellIds' array on the surface.

parameters.name: nonlinear_subdivision
parameters.description: Subdivision level for nonlinear (higher-order) cells; 1 matches the default.
